$comment: The site config of this repository (CI.md of the template, "The site config"). The Pages workflow deploys this site from main, and a job of ci.yml checks it on each pull request.
build:
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts clone --owners --into "$RUNNER_TEMP/repos"
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts build --repos-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/repos" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas.json" --markdown "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas.md"
node packages/site/src/build.ts --atlas "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas.json" --markdown "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas.md" --out packages/site/dist
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts corpus --repos-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/repos" --out packages/site/dist/data/corpus.json --markdown "$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus.md"
# Layer 1a: the catalog of the facts of each blob. The command fails when a hash breaks the law of the chain.
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts catalog --repos-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/repos" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/catalog.sqlite" --markdown "$RUNNER_TEMP/facts.md"
# The trend: the file of the last deploy, with the point of this build. The command previous-trend reads the
# site of each owner, the current owner first, then the Pages artifact of the last deploy. Only a repository
# with no deploy has no trend (exit code 3). Each other failure stops the build, so a build does not lose the
# history. The flag --owners removes the rows of each repository that is not public at this time from each old
# point. The totals of a point stay.
code=0
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts previous-trend --owners --repo codeatlas --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/trend.json" || code=$?
case "$code" in
  0) node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts trend --db "$RUNNER_TEMP/catalog.sqlite" --previous "$RUNNER_TEMP/trend.json" --owners --out packages/site/dist/data/trend.json ;;
  3) echo "::warning::The repository has no deploy: the trend starts with this build."
     node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts trend --db "$RUNNER_TEMP/catalog.sqlite" --owners --out packages/site/dist/data/trend.json ;;
  *) exit 1 ;;
esac
# The query set: the duplication of each level, the exact copies, the complex functions and the markers.
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts queries --db "$RUNNER_TEMP/catalog.sqlite" --out packages/site/dist/data/queries.json
# The dimension catalog: the state of each dimension, the summary of its values, and the cause and next step of each gap.
node packages/atlas/src/cli.ts dimensions --db "$RUNNER_TEMP/catalog.sqlite" --catalog packages/site/dist/data/dimensions.json
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas.md" "$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus.md" "$RUNNER_TEMP/facts.md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
